subject: Please update where you send remittance advices
text:
Hello,

Please update the email address you use for remittance advices for Cobalt Freight. Going forward, send them to remittance@cobaltfreight.com instead of ar@cobaltfreight.com. This is just for the payment detail emails so we can apply cash faster; please keep paying to the same bank account as always.

Thank you,
Jasmine Ortega
Billing, Cobalt Freight LLC
label: ordinary
note: Borderline wording: 'update', 'remittance', 'going forward, send them to ... instead of'. It changes where the remittance advice email goes, not where money lands.
